operations.summary: Generate one Target from a Definition
operations.description:
Stateless generation: nothing is stored. Returns the full generated
package as files. Works without an API key: anonymous calls generate
the first 25 operations, rate limited per IP address, and the
response's `limits` object says what was held back and where to lift
it; anonymous calls from a Definition URL also carry `claim.url`, a link
that turns the run into a project once a person signs in. With a key, the free plan generates the first 25 operations and
paid plans generate the complete Definition. A present but invalid key is a
401, not a downgrade to anonymous.

Idempotency-Key.description: Identifies one logical write for 24 hours. The key is scoped to the authenticated account and operation; account-less generation uses a hashed network identity. Retrying the same method, path, query, and JSON body replays the original response. Reusing the key with changed intent returns 409. After expiry the key starts a new write.

definition.description: A Definition for stateless generation, provided as exactly one URL or inline entrypoint.

url.description:
URL of an OpenAPI document, a GraphQL SDL file, or a GraphQL
endpoint (introspected automatically). Fetched server-side.

headers.description: Request headers for a protected URL. Sent on the document GET and GraphQL introspection POST, never returned or retained by stateless generation.

inline.description: Raw Definition text (OpenAPI JSON/YAML or GraphQL SDL). Up to 10MB.

target.description: Stateless generator descriptor; no persisted Target is created.

generator.description: Generator implementation selected by a Target. This is configuration, not identity; several Targets may use the same generator.

package_name.description: npm package or Python distribution override. Valid only for the TypeScript and Python SDK targets.

module_path.description: Go module path override. Valid only for the Go SDK. Linked projects derive this from the Go destination repository by default.

config.description: Everything Typeship needs beyond the Definition, in one object: generation customization (globals, retries, pagination, readme) and how the generated tooling behaves (cli, mcp, package, docs_url). Plain configuration. Typeship never requires vendor extensions inside the Definition itself. Stateless generation also accepts GraphQL settings here; stored projects keep those settings on their Definition.

globals.description: Wire names of query/header parameters that become settable once on the generated client and auto-apply to every operation that accepts them; per-call values win. Names that match nothing are reported as generation warnings.

retries.description: Retry behavior. Top-level fields adjust every operation; operations maps operationId or "METHOD /path" keys to per-operation overrides.

pagination.description: Per-operation pagination control, keyed by operationId or "METHOD /path". Unmatched keys are reported as generation warnings.

items_field.description: Response field holding the item array.

anyOf.description: false disables pagination detection for the operation.

graphql.description: What a GraphQL schema cannot say about itself. Ignored for OpenAPI specs.

endpoint.description: The URL every request is POSTed to; the generated client's default baseUrl. Defaults to the URL the schema was fetched from. Without either, baseUrl is a required client option.

environments.description: Named endpoints (sandbox, production). Each becomes a client environment; the first is the default unless endpoint is set.

auth.description: How requests authenticate. bearer sends Authorization: Bearer; basic is for key-pair APIs (public key as username, private key as password); api_key sends a header named by api_key_header; none generates no auth option.

api_key_header.description: Header carrying the key when auth is api_key. Required for that mode; Typeship does not invent a vendor-specific header name.

title.description: The API's name; drives the package and client names ("Acme" gives acme and AcmeClient). Defaults to a name derived from the endpoint's host.

scalars.description: JSON representation of each custom scalar, keyed by GraphQL scalar name. Unmapped scalars generate as the language's untyped JSON value and produce a warning. Unmatched keys warn.

cli.description: How the generated CLI behaves. Part of Config.

command_name.description: Command users run, independent of how the CLI is distributed.

whoami_operation.description: resource.method of a zero-argument GET that the generated CLI's whoami command calls. Overrides auto-detection; a value that matches nothing is reported as a generation warning.

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client id baked into the generated CLI for device-flow login. Without it, login prompts for a pasted credential.

oauth_scopes.description: Scopes requested during device-flow login. Include offline_access if the authorization server gates refresh tokens behind it.

oauth_audience.description: Audience sent with the device-authorization request, for authorization servers that require one to issue API-valid access tokens.

update_notice.description: Opt in to a once-a-day registry check that prints an upgrade hint. Off by default; generated code phones nobody unless this is enabled.

support_url.description: Where the generated CLI's feedback command sends users. GitHub issues/new URLs get a prefilled title and environment details.

auth_url.description: Base URL of the browser-approval endpoint pair used by CLI login. The CLI keeps the verifier and receives the credential directly; no key is pasted through a conversation.

mcp_url.description: Hosted MCP endpoint installed by the generated CLI instead of launching the package's local stdio server.

skills_repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the skills package the generated CLI offers to install during init.

mcp.description: How the generated MCP server and the hosted endpoint behave. Part of Config.

registry_name.description: Stable official MCP registry name, independent of the server runtime.

tool_mode.description: MCP tool shape. meta collapses per-operation tools into search_docs, read_docs, and execute so large APIs don't flood an agent's context window. Auto considers the serialized tool schemas, switching near 10k tokens or above 100 operations.

instructions.description: Guidance appended to the MCP server's instructions, which agents read once when they connect (server/discover): what to call first, conventions the spec does not state, what not to do. Carried by the package's server and the hosted endpoint alike.

tool_descriptions.description: Hand-written MCP tool descriptions keyed by operationId or "METHOD /path". Each replaces the text typeship derives for that operation (summary, first sentence, method and path, deprecation and auth notes). For flows the spec cannot describe, such as a multi-step upload. Keys that match no operation are reported as generation warnings.

reference_resolvers.description: Exact name-or-ID resolver overrides keyed first by the target operationId or "METHOD /path", then by its wire argument name. A resolver names one read collection operation plus 1-4 item fields to match case-insensitively; false opts that argument out of strict inference.

readme.description: Generated README behavior. Part of Config.

quickstart_operation.description: operationId or "METHOD /path" to feature as the README's first API call. It must be present in the generated package and callable with no required input beyond path placeholders. Missing or unsuitable choices produce a warning and use the automatic example.

package.description: Published-package metadata the API spec does not own. Repository is derived from each destination.

license.description: SPDX identifier written into registry metadata. Defaults to info.license.

license_text.description: Exact LICENSE file contents. Supply this for licences the engine does not build in; MIT is built in when copyright is also set.

copyright.description: Copyright line used in generated license files.

go_package_name.description: Go identifier when the destination repository name is unsuitable.

docs_url.description: The API's documentation site. Read through its llms.txt by the generated CLI's docs command, the MCP server's docs tools, and the package's AGENTS.md. Defaults to the Definition's externalDocs URL.

docs_index_url.description: Exact llms.txt URL when the documentation site does not publish it at docs_url + /llms.txt.

path.description: Repo-relative path inside the generated package.

api_version.description: Version declared by the customer's API Definition.

version.description: Package version selected by the Target's release stream for this generation.

converted.description: True when the input was Swagger 2.0 and was converted.

artifact_name.description: Ecosystem-neutral identity of the generated artifact.

generators.description: Generator implementations present in this artifact.

items.description: Generator implementation selected by a Target.

omitted_operation_count.description: Operations beyond the plan's endpoint allowance, not generated.

omitted_operations.description: METHOD/path identities of operations omitted by the generation cap.

pr_url.description: Pull request opened by this regeneration, when one was.

pr_status.description: Whether a destination pull request opened, was unnecessary because the generated tree already match…

pr_error.description: Why the configured destination pull request was not opened.

changelog.description: Markdown changelog entry for this regeneration, from the API surface diff.

breaking_count.description: Breaking changes in the diff; removed methods and fields, changed types, inputs that became required.

baseline.description: What the diff was measured against; "destination" means the .typeship/surface.json merged in the de…

api_compatibility.description: Objective compatibility of the generated API surface against the merged destination baseline.

package_compatibility.description: Objective compatibility of public package entry points and selected targets against the merged dest…

version_correct.description: Whether the generated package version satisfies the cumulative change.

release_readiness.description: The destination pull request's combined readiness decision for the exact bot-generated head.

release_readiness_note.description: The release-readiness decision in one line, as the commit status describes it.

previous_version.description: The package version the destination had before this regeneration.

diagnostics.description: Deterministic Diagnostic summary for the exact Definition Revision consumed.

summary.description: Counts distinguish decisions from the number of affected schema locations.

occurrences.description: Total affected locations across all diagnostics.

auto_fixable.description: Diagnostics with exact reviewable Definition patches.

limits.description: Present when the generation was capped: by the free plan, or because the call was anonymous.

max_operations.description: How many operations this generation was allowed to include.

generated_operations.description: How many operations are present in the generated package.

omitted_operations.description: How many operations in the Definition were left out.

total_operations.description: How many operations Typeship found in the complete Definition.

request_id.description: Server-generated identifier used to correlate this response with Typeship logs.

limit.description: Maximum number of resources to return. Default: 20.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding page's next_cursor. Valid only for the same account, operation, filters, and ordering that issued it.

items.description: Lean Project identity returned by collection endpoints. Retrieve the Project for shared configuration and list its Targets for the complete canonical child collection.

id.description: Unique identifier for a project.

definition_id.description: Unique identifier for a project's logical API Definition.

nextPage.description: Arguments that fetch the next page; pass them to this tool

truncated.description: Present when the page was cut to fit the result size cap: how many items were omitted and how to get them

operations.description: Stores a URL- or GitHub-sourced project. Free includes one stored project, every selected target, and the first 25 operations, while keeping manual and automatic regeneration, history, destination pull requests, and preview checks. Stateless POST /generate does not consume this slot. Pro adds projects and generates every operation in the Definition.

Idempotency-Key.description: Identifies one logical write for 24 hours. The key is scoped to the authenticated account and operation; account-less generation uses a hashed network identity. Retrying the same method, path, query, and JSON body replays the original response. Reusing the key with changed intent returns 409. After expiry the key starts a new write.

url.description: URL of an OpenAPI document, GraphQL SDL file, or GraphQL endpoint.

headers.description: Request headers for a protected URL. Values are never returned or recorded in revision history. When updating the same URL, omit headers to preserve the stored values or pass null to remove them. Changing the URL without headers clears the old values so a credential is never forwarded to a different source.

provider.description: GitHub is the only launch provider; the field is stable for future adapters.

identifier.description: Provider-native repository identity, opaque outside its adapter.

items.description:
A fix applied to the resolved Definition before generation. Paths are JSON
Pointers into the document. A patch whose target no longer exists is
skipped and reported as a warning on the generation, never silently.

path.description:
JSON-Pointer-style path. Pattern segments enable bulk fixes:
* (any child), ** (any depth), [key=value] (filter), e.g.
/paths/**/parameters/[name=account_id]/schema/type. Renaming a
schema under /components/schemas also rewrites its $refs.

to.description: rename only; the new key name.

graphql.description: GraphQL-only endpoint, auth, environment, title, and scalar settings.

anyOf.description: What a GraphQL schema cannot say about itself. Ignored for OpenAPI specs.

endpoint.description: The URL every request is POSTed to; the generated client's default baseUrl. Defaults to the URL the schema was fetched from. Without either, baseUrl is a required client option.

diagnostic_policy.description: Source pull-request enforcement threshold, new-versus-complete baseline, and explicitly reviewed rule or location exceptions.

fail_on.description: Severity threshold that fails the API change review check.

only_new.description: Enforce only occurrences introduced by the proposed source change.

path.description: Exact schema coordinate. Omit only to suppress every occurrence of the rule.

reason.description: The reviewed product decision behind this exception.

targets.description: Initial first-class Targets. More than one may use the same generator with different identities or Deliveries.

generator.description: Generator implementation selected by a Target. This is configuration, not identity; several Targets may use the same generator.

operations.summary: Generate targets and open pull requests
operations.description:
Resolves the project's URL or GitHub source, generates every
configured delivery package, stores each result in the project's history,
and attempts to open a pull request in every configured destination.
When the complete generated tree already matches a destination, no
commit, branch, or pull request is created and that generation reports
`pr_status: no_changes`. This is the same pipeline automatic
regeneration runs after a source change.

items.description:
A fix applied to the resolved Definition before generation. Paths are JSON
Pointers into the document. A patch whose target no longer exists is
skipped and reported as a warning on the generation, never silently.

path.description:
JSON-Pointer-style path. Pattern segments enable bulk fixes:
* (any child), ** (any depth), [key=value] (filter), e.g.
/paths/**/parameters/[name=account_id]/schema/type. Renaming a
schema under /components/schemas also rewrites its $refs.

to.description: rename only; the new key name.

anyOf.description: What a GraphQL schema cannot say about itself. Ignored for OpenAPI specs.

endpoint.description: The URL every request is POSTed to; the generated client's default baseUrl. Defaults to the URL the schema was fetched from. Without either, baseUrl is a required client option.

auth.description: How requests authenticate. bearer sends Authorization: Bearer; basic is for key-pair APIs (public key as username, private key as password); api_key sends a header named by api_key_header; none generates no auth option.

api_key_header.description: Header carrying the key when auth is api_key. Required for that mode; Typeship does not invent a vendor-specific header name.

title.description: The API's name; drives the package and client names ("Acme" gives acme and AcmeClient). Defaults to a name derived from the endpoint's host.

scalars.description: JSON representation of each custom scalar, keyed by GraphQL scalar name. Unmapped scalars generate as the language's untyped JSON value and produce a warning. Unmatched keys warn.

only_new.description: Enforce only occurrences introduced by the proposed source change.

path.description: Exact schema coordinate. Omit only to suppress every occurrence of the rule.

config.description: Target-specific overrides merged over Project.config. GraphQL settings are rejected here and belong to the Definition.

anyOf.description: Shared generated-client and tooling behavior for a stored Project. Every Target inherits these defaults. Target.config is merged over them for one Target; top-level values replace defaults while cli, mcp, readme, and package merge by field. GraphQL-only source settings live on the Project's Definition and are rejected in both stored config scopes.

globals.description: Wire names of query/header parameters that become settable once on the generated client and auto-apply to every operation that accepts them; per-call values win. Names that match nothing are reported as generation warnings.

retries.description: Retry behavior. Top-level fields adjust every operation; operations maps operationId or "METHOD /path" keys to per-operation overrides.

pagination.description: Per-operation pagination control, keyed by operationId or "METHOD /path". Unmatched keys are reported as generation warnings.

anyOf.description: false disables pagination detection for the operation.

cli.description: How the generated CLI behaves. Part of Config.

command_name.description: Command users run, independent of how the CLI is distributed.

whoami_operation.description: resource.method of a zero-argument GET that the generated CLI's whoami command calls. Overrides auto-detection; a value that matches nothing is reported as a generation warning.

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client id baked into the generated CLI for device-flow login. Without it, login prompts for a pasted credential.

oauth_scopes.description: Scopes requested during device-flow login. Include offline_access if the authorization server gates refresh tokens behind it.

oauth_audience.description: Audience sent with the device-authorization request, for authorization servers that require one to issue API-valid access tokens.

update_notice.description: Opt in to a once-a-day registry check that prints an upgrade hint. Off by default; generated code phones nobody unless this is enabled.

support_url.description: Where the generated CLI's feedback command sends users. GitHub issues/new URLs get a prefilled title and environment details.

auth_url.description: Base URL of the browser-approval endpoint pair used by CLI login. The CLI keeps the verifier and receives the credential directly; no key is pasted through a conversation.

mcp_url.description: Hosted MCP endpoint installed by the generated CLI instead of launching the package's local stdio server.

skills_repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the skills package the generated CLI offers to install during init.

mcp.description: How the generated MCP server and the hosted endpoint behave. Part of Config.

registry_name.description: Stable official MCP registry name, independent of the server runtime.

tool_mode.description: MCP tool shape. meta collapses per-operation tools into search_docs, read_docs, and execute so large APIs don't flood an agent's context window. Auto considers the serialized tool schemas, switching near 10k tokens or above 100 operations.

instructions.description: Guidance appended to the MCP server's instructions, which agents read once when they connect (server/discover): what to call first, conventions the spec does not state, what not to do. Carried by the package's server and the hosted endpoint alike.

tool_descriptions.description: Hand-written MCP tool descriptions keyed by operationId or "METHOD /path". Each replaces the text typeship derives for that operation (summary, first sentence, method and path, deprecation and auth notes). For flows the spec cannot describe, such as a multi-step upload. Keys that match no operation are reported as generation warnings.

reference_resolvers.description: Exact name-or-ID resolver overrides keyed first by the target operationId or "METHOD /path", then by its wire argument name. A resolver names one read collection operation plus 1-4 item fields to match case-insensitively; false opts that argument out of strict inference.

readme.description: Generated README behavior. Part of Config.

quickstart_operation.description: operationId or "METHOD /path" to feature as the README's first API call. It must be present in the generated package and callable with no required input beyond path placeholders. Missing or unsuitable choices produce a warning and use the automatic example.

license.description: SPDX identifier written into registry metadata. Defaults to info.license.

license_text.description: Exact LICENSE file contents. Supply this for licences the engine does not build in; MIT is built in when copyright is also set.

copyright.description: Copyright line used in generated license files.

go_package_name.description: Go identifier when the destination repository name is unsuitable.

docs_url.description: The API's documentation site. Read through its llms.txt by the generated CLI's docs command, the MCP server's docs tools, and the package's AGENTS.md. Defaults to the Definition's externalDocs URL.

docs_index_url.description: Exact llms.txt URL when the documentation site does not publish it at docs_url + /llms.txt.
